verdict.rationale: Lever offers an AI Form Builder where users 'describe the form you need' in natural language ([lever-docs-24]), and AI-generated interview questions/guides ([lever-docs-27]), showing pockets of natural-language interaction. However, there's no evidence of a general natural-language command interface, chat-based control of the ATS, or AI agent that operates the whole product via NL commands. missing for 10: a general-purpose natural-language command/chat interface for operating core Lever workflows (scheduling, pipeline actions, reporting) beyond isolated AI form/question generation, and independent confirmation of these AI features' reliability.
